title: The Placebo Effect: How Belief Becomes Biology
question: How can an inert pill produce real, measurable changes in the body, and what does that reveal about the link between expectation and physiology?
summary: Placebos can trigger endogenous opioids and dopamine, work even when patients know they are fake, and have a harmful twin in the nocebo effect — offering a striking view of how the brain's predictions shape bodily experience.
